name: dao-tale
description: Aplicativo local de tradução e revisão assistida (chinês → PT-BR)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.test: npm -w server run test && npm -w web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
